summary: The Beachbody Company, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting its entry into Amendment No. 2 to its Credit Agreement, dated August 3, 2026, with lenders and Tiger Finance, LLC as agent. The amendment modifies financial covenants, reducing the minimum cash threshold to $22.5 million, eliminating the billings fixed charge coverage ratio, increasing minimum liquidity to $18 million (stepping down to $16 million by March 2027), lowering minimum digital subscriptions to 650,000 (then 550,000), and raising the billings target to 92.5% of forecast, while fixing the interest rate at SOFR plus 9.00%. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
